CollationIdentity.description: Calcite omits built-in singleton collations from type digests, but includes separately constructed named collations with the same name and coercibility.

DiagnosticSource.description: Text used in diagnostics, never an executable function body or SQL fallback.

ExactDecimal.description: Integer text is a signed base-ten coefficient, without exponent notation. Scale is explicit and may be negative; decoding never routes through f64.

oneOf.description: Reuse the standalone literal contract. Its type and origin must equal the expression header, including exact arena IDs.
Aggregate invocation owned by a window group. Its evaluation depends on that group even when it has no ordinary expression arguments.
Body in the whole-plan object graph. Its input/source environment is explicit and isolated from callers' lambda frames.
A planner host value. The adapter permits only its known geometry class.

Identifier.description: Retain the spelling and quoting independently. Case folding belongs to the binder and must not be repeated during decoding.

declaration.description: Preserve whether the declaration and a body reference share one node.

oneOf.description: Local calendar fields; no implicit timezone conversion occurs here.
The instant and timezone presentation remain distinct.
Preserve a local calendar value and its zone label before resolving DST gaps or overlaps. This differs from an already resolved instant.
Calcite stores year/month intervals as months and day/time intervals as milliseconds. Preserve its exact decimal payload without rounding.
JTS Point subset used by current Java lowering. Ordinates are raw IEEE bits in coordinate-sequence order; empty points have no ordinates.
Rows retain each field's own type, including typed NULLs.
Preserve entry ordering and duplicates until the adapter proves its map semantics; deserialization must not collapse keys into a HashMap.
A separately allocated, stateless SUM0. The standard-table singleton continues to use Builtin; equal fresh objects must not be interned.

A compiler-derived range with partially unknown coordinates. Zero is an explicit unknown component here, not a one-based source coordinate. Retain the known components and source identity without inventing text locations. Fully unknown positions use Absent instead.

Precision.description: An omitted precision differs from an explicitly specified precision. This tagged representation also makes an accidental missing field an error.

QualifiedName.description: Retain both the overall name position and the optional component positions. An absent component-position list is distinct from a list of absent origins.

ResolvedOperator.description: One instantiated signature references a resolved operator object. Different signatures may share that object. The model checks references and signatures, not builtin registry membership or independent SQL type inference.

RowFieldNames.description: A missing list means default names for every field. Null entries in an explicit list request the default name for those individual fields.

parent.description: Every binding belongs to exactly one scope. Parents supply lexical visibility; ordinary input bindings are usable only in their own scope.

explicit_scale.description: Distinguish DECIMAL(p) from DECIMAL(p, 0) while retaining resolved scale.

oneOf.description: FLOAT and DOUBLE lower alike but remain distinct SQL type names.
These planner forms are represented explicitly, but are not a promise that arbitrary values of them can pass the lowering verifier.
Planner descriptors, not ordinary runtime scalar values.
